detail: Load PRSA station-level air-quality and weather CSV files.
Check schema, duplicate rows, AQI bounds, time coverage, and numeric missingness.
Drop duplicates, fill station names, and fill numeric gaps with station-aware forward/backward fill plus median fallback.
Create hazardous_air_day_flag and tomorrows_aqi_value without using future features.
Scale source-safe pollutant and weather features with StandardScaler.
